items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: the same way I left Basie; you know, I went to Basie's band.

ctx.x: I got out of there in a hurry, man. You know? Because what... So it's a big thing. So you're on staff. So what the hell does that mean? "Oh, yeah, I'm in the studio. I'm on staff." But if you ain't doin' nothin', hell, it ain't gonna mean nothin'. I'm not trying to impress nobody. I want to play.

Yeah, I'll (?) the same way I left Basie; you know, I went to Basie's band. Sit up there, doin' nothin' or... Hell, read music? I've been through that. I went over there because I thought I'd play some of them arrangements, you know, with Jo? Have some fun, you know. I didn't go over there to prove how much I could read. I did all of that!
Man, I very seldom got a chance to play with that band.
